title: Shuffle the order of lines in a text file
summary: Use the shuf command to randomly reorder the lines of a text file. This is useful for creating random lists or test data.

steps.explain: Run shuf with the path to your file to print the lines in a random order to the terminal.

placeholders.name: FILE
placeholders.description: Path to the text file you want to shuffle

alternatives.explain: Output only the first 5 shuffled lines instead of all of them.
